recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — Leaf domain types: LeaveType + LeaveStatus
recommended_phases.rationale: Pure enums/models with zero dependencies. Must exist before any module that references them.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — AuditLog infrastructure module
recommended_phases.rationale: Cross-cutting audit concern required by GP-002. No domain dependencies; depends only on shared/db.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — Employee module
recommended_phases.rationale: Employee lookup and manager relationship queries. Depends on AuditLog for state-change recording.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4 — LeavePolicy module
recommended_phases.rationale: Policy rules (max days, approval requirements) per leave type. Depends only on LeaveType.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 5 — Balance module
recommended_phases.rationale: Leave balance tracking, deduction, and restoration. Depends on LeaveType and AuditLog.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 6 — Notification module
recommended_phases.rationale: Notification fanout for leave lifecycle events. No domain dependencies; depends on shared infrastructure (BullMQ).

recommended_phases.title: Phase 7 — LeaveRequest model + repository + service interface
recommended_phases.rationale: Core model, persistence contract, and service contract. Depends on all prior modules' interfaces.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 8 — LeaveRequest service implementation
recommended_phases.rationale: Orchestrates apply/approve/reject/cancel with policy checks, balance deduction, audit, and notifications. Most complex file.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 9 — LeaveRequest controller + routes + wiring
recommended_phases.rationale: Fastify routes with RBAC guards (GP-005), input validation (GP-003), and app.ts registration.

app_notes: Application layer design for leave management module. Eight modules with strict inward dependency flow: LeaveType and LeaveStatus are leaf enums (zero deps). AuditLog is cross-cutting infrastructure. Employee, LeavePolicy, Balance, and Notification are domain services consumed by LeaveRequest. LeaveRequest is the orchestration module that wires everything together — it depends on all other modules but nothing depends on it. All service interfaces defined before implementations. No circular dependencies verified. Nine phases ordered by dependency: leaf types first, then infrastructure, then domain services, then orchestration, then HTTP surface.
